summary: Iteration 5 tested backend + mobile UI (390x844). All new behaviours PASS. Backend (test_iteration5.py, 17 passed + 1 skipped): (a) POST /api/upload as admin returns {url,path}; the url is /api/files/<path>; GET /api/files/<path> returns image bytes with image/* Content-Type (PNG magic bytes verified). (b) text/plain upload => 400 'Nur Bilddateien'. (c) Sales upload => 403; Customer upload => 403. (d) POST/PUT /api/products accept and persist description + imageUrl; admin GET /api/products round-trips them. (e) Role hiding on /api/products: admin has cost/salesFloor/absoluteFloor; sales has NO cost but keeps salesFloor & absoluteFloor; customer has NO cost, salesFloor, absoluteFloor. (f) Role hiding on /api/analytics?months=6: admin gets showMargin=true, totalMargin, marginPct AND per-row 'margin'; sales gets showMargin=false, NO totalMargin/marginPct and NO 'margin' key on any row; customer => 403. (g) Regression: 3-role login, offer create+approve+reject, order create+advance+cancel, customer-prices + price-history, invoice pay all still work; unique sequential IDs intact (B-2026-01001+, A-2026-0201+, p5+). Frontend (mobile 390x844): ADMIN /produkte -> add-product form contains 'Beschreibung' (p-description), 'Bild auswählen' image area (pick-image), 'Einkaufspreis' (p-cost); saving TEST_UIBrand with description shows product-saved-msg, the new product row is visible in the list, and its description text renders. Tapping the new product row opens the form pre-filled with description='UI Beschreibung Test'. ADMIN /auswertungen shows Umsatz+Marge+Menge chips, 'Marge %' pill, subtitle 'Umsatz, Marge & Menge'. ADMIN /angebote create-offer form -> after picking product+price the 'DB/Monat · DB/kg' line IS shown. SALES /auswertungen: Umsatz+Menge chips ONLY, NO Marge chip, NO 'Marge %' pill, subtitle 'Umsatz & Menge'. SALES /angebote: DB/Monat & DB/kg line is NOT shown. Cleanup performed via /app/cleanup_iter5.py: deleted 6 TEST_ products (p5..p10, counter reset to 4), 24 test orders (counter reset to 1000), 6 test offers (counter reset to 200); restored B-2026-00987 to status='Neu' with cancel/tracking fields unset; restored invoices RE-2026-0921/0850/0870 to their seeded statuses. Uploads collection audit rows preserved (bytes remain in Emergent Object Storage - not user-visible). Non-blocking pre-existing warnings: shadow* RN-web deprecation (from iter 3), 'props.pointerEvents is deprecated' + 'TouchableMixin is deprecated' from gifted-charts (harmless, per handoff note). Old test files test_iteration2/3/test_ss_backend.py use 'from tests.conftest import ...' and only import when pytest runs from /app/backend, not /app - pre-existing, not iter5 regression; iter4+iter5 (27 tests) do pass cleanly from either cwd.

critical_code_review_comments: server.py:265-279 get_products cleanly strips cost for sales and cost+salesFloor+absoluteFloor for customer. Good defense-in-depth (backend also hides on top of frontend gating).

server.py:302-329 upload_image validates content-type against ALLOWED_IMAGE_TYPES, 8 MB cap, uses run_in_threadpool to avoid blocking the event loop, stores a uploads-collection audit row keyed by storagePath. Path scheme '{APP_NAME}/uploads/{userId}/{uuid}.{ext}' avoids collisions.

server.py:332-341 serve_file requires the storagePath to exist in db.uploads before fetching -> prevents arbitrary storage-path enumeration. Returns Cache-Control: public max-age=86400 which is appropriate.

server.py:664-720 analytics gates margin behind is_admin — row-level 'margin' key is only added for admin (not just zeroed). Correct — a client dumping the JSON as sales sees no margin footprint at all.
server.py:302 ALLOWED_IMAGE_TYPES includes image/heic and image/heif — good for iPhone camera roll; PIL/browsers won't render heic though, consider re-encoding server-side later.
server.py:44-58 init_storage caches _storage_key process-wide with lazy init; get_object catches 503 to re-init. Good resiliency pattern.
server.py:311 8 MB upload cap: implemented by reading file into memory first — for large uploads a streaming approach would be safer, but 8 MB is fine as-is.
frontend/(tabs)/auswertungen.tsx:35 metrics filtered by isAdmin AND effect at line 37 auto-resets metric to 'revenue' if sales somehow lands on 'margin' -> defensive, prevents stale query state.
frontend/(tabs)/angebote.tsx:312 DB/Monat + DB/kg line gated on `parsed && isAdmin` (product.cost is also undefined for sales because backend strips it — no NaN leak).

frontend/produkte.tsx form loads image via pick-image (native picker) and uploads to /api/upload; on web the picker is not automatable. Backend upload path is fully covered by test_iteration5.TestUpload.
frontend/produkte.tsx OK save flow keeps form open on create for rapid multi-add (verified in iter 4) and closes on edit — still working; description now round-trips into the row.
